items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: certain musicians, the people that played my music and asked me for tunes were ... Steve Kuhn, who had just come to town, and he’s still playing some of my tunes.

ctx.x: Claude Thornhill, he wrote for Claude Thornhill’s band.

I hadn’t heard that yet. Not until I went to New York. When I went to New York that was a totally different story. It becomes a different... it’s almost like the curtain opens right now. When I got to New York I stopped at Cafe Bohemia for Miles Davis and Philly Joe Jones, and I think Wynton Marsalis, no... Fred Karlin? And... oh I temporarily forget who the tenor player was... but Steve’s favorite bass player....
Was it Wynton Kelly on piano?
